units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68:4">Gen. R. s. 68</cite>, beg. <he>אין זִיוּוּגוֹ של וכ׳</he> man’s conjugal destiny is decreed by the Lord; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 70:1">Yalk. Jud. 70</cite> <he>זוֹגוֹ</he> or <he>זִוְגּוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="G00122"><he>זֶוֶג</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 70:1">Ib.</cite> <he>יש שהוא הולך אצל זיווגו וכ׳</he> (Yalk. <he>זוגו</he>) one must travel to meet her who is designated for him, to another she travels to meet him.

Midr. Till. to Ps. LIX ייחד הב״ה שמו על הז׳ the Lord has His special name connected with marriage (Gen. XXIV, 50; Jud. XIV, 4; Prov. XIX, 14); a. fr.—Trnsf. a corresponding case, solace offered by pointing to a similar case (v. זָוַג).

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 30:1">Pesik. R. s. 30</cite> <he>מבקשים ז׳ לירושלים וכ׳</he> were looking out for a similar bereavement as a solace to Jerusalem and could not find any (ref. to <cite ref="Lamentations 2:13">Lam. II, 13</cite>).

<cite ref="Lamentations 2:13">Ib.</cite> the Lord said <he>אני אהיה זִיוּוּגָךְ</he> I will be thy partner in misery (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 43:14">Is. XLIII, 14</cite>).—Pl. <he>זִיוּוּגִים</he>, <he>זִיוּוּגִין</he>, <he>זִוּוּ׳</he>. Gen. R. l. c.; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 8:3">Lev. R. s. 8</cite>, beg.; a. e.
